steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: seed-version
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); const savedAt = new Date().toISOString(); const state = { version: 2, apartmentId: 'serangoon-north-vista-4r', items: st.items.slice(0, 20), doors: st.doors, finishes: st.finishes, userFurniture: [], userMaterials: [], timeMode: st.timeMode || 'manual', manualHour: st.manualHour || 13, cameraMode: st.cameraMode || 'orbit', savedAt }; localStorage.setItem('sofa-so-good:save:test-v1', JSON.stringify(state)); const idx = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sofa-so-good:save-index') || '[]'); idx.push({ slot: 'test-v1', savedAt }); localStorage.setItem('sofa-so-good:save-index', JSON.stringify(idx)); })()

steps.name: click-compare-3d
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Compare in 3D' || (b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim() === 'Compare in 3D'); if (!b) throw new Error('no Compare in 3D button'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-no-leak
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.past.length !== window.__hist) throw new Error('history leaked: ' + window.__hist + ' -> ' + s.past.length); if (s.items.length !== window.__items) throw new Error('items not restored: ' + window.__items + ' -> ' + s.items.length); return 'no leak, restored'; })()
